note: Browsing classes read from the printed product name. Not an AMT heading, not a PubChem annotation, and not a family guess. A product with no matching rule has classDerived null. Boron class, PEG architecture and dye core apply only inside the family AMT already assigned. NHS, maleimide and DBCO patterns also run on every family.

rules.note: Pinacol, or both tetramethyl and dioxaborolan in the name. A bare dioxaborolane is not a pinacol ester.
Skipped when the name also says ester, so a neopentyl glycol ester is not labelled as the free acid. Pinacol esters are caught by the earlier rule.

reactiveGroups.note: NHS, succinimidyl, the IUPAC fragment 2,5-dioxopyrrolidin-1-yl, and the bounded linker abbreviations SC, SCM, SVA and SS (succinimidyl succinate). A SKU suffix is not read.
maleimide, the bounded abbreviation Mal, or the IUPAC fragment pyrrole-2,5-dione. That fragment does not match a DPP pigment such as pyrrolo[3,4-c]pyrrole-1,4-dione.
DBCO, dibenzocyclooctyne, or the printed abbreviation ADIBO (azadibenzocyclooctyne).
The IUPAC prefix amino and the suffix amine are both the amine token. A protected name that still says amino matches.
A name that says both acid and ester, such as a tert-butyl ester of a carbamic acid, is not labelled acid.

architecture.note: Only those tokens. A methoxyethoxy chain without mPEG or Me-PEG is not labelled mPEG.
The word heterobifunctional, or two different reactive groups from the list above. Two copies of one group, such as N3-PEG-N3, stay a single group and do not set this architecture.

rules.note: A cyanine name that does not already state Cy3, Cy5, Cy5.5 or Cy7. sulfo-Cy is covered by those numbered rules, not by a bare sulfo prefix.

The token BODIPY, or the printed IUPAC fragment diazaborinin. The missing syllable in diazaborinin-4-ium-5-uide is the PDF text layer and is not corrected. Fluorescein, rhodamine and coumarin names that do not use these tokens stay null.
